name: AI for Database
summary: Natural-language access to your own databases: ask questions in plain English, get answers with charts, saved SQL, dashboards, scheduled workflows and alerts, with PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, SQL Server and Google Sheets connections.
best_for: small teams without a data analyst who want to ask their own database questions in plain English and turn the answers into dashboards and scheduled alerts
skip_if: you need a fixed monthly price with no usage credits, require SSO on a standard plan, or want a free AI allowance you can rely on
honest_knock: The homepage says "Free plan available - No credit card required", but the pricing FAQ says AI usage requires credits, so we could not confirm any free AI allowance beyond the sample-data start. The price page does not say how many questions a dollar of credit buys. SSO/SAML is not included in Pro or Team, and the self-hosted price is not published.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Pro · Pro billed monthly per user, excluding taxes
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-05 on aifordatabase.com/pricing) AI for Database sells per user, and every payment turns into that user's own AI credits. Pro costs $10 per user per month and adds $10 of credits per payment; Team costs $30 per user per month and adds $30 of credits per payment, plus per-user usage tracking, assigned connections, audit logs and shared dashboards and workflows. Annual billing is 20% less than twelve monthly payments: $96 per user for Pro and $288 per user for Team, with the full amount added as credits. Credits do not expire and do not reset each month. AI usage pauses when a user's balance runs out; a user can top up with $10, $25, $50 or $100. Prices and credits exclude applicable taxes. Enterprise is custom priced and covers SSO requirements, security reviews and contract terms; the pricing page says SSO/SAML is not included in Pro or Team. Self-hosting is available separately and its price is not published. The pricing page does not say how many questions a dollar of credit buys, so the real monthly cost depends on how much you ask.
